__comment: Vertical expansion (one-agent-five-doors) system-health dashboard. Import via Grafana → Dashboards → New → Import → paste this JSON. Metric names assume the as-built OTLP→Prometheus translation (dots→underscores, counters get _total; see setup/grafana-observability-setup.md). If a panel is empty after deploy, verify names with the Grafana MCP: list_prometheus_metric_names(regex='cos_.*'). Counters reset on every deploy — panels use increase() over wide windows on purpose.
title: Vertical Expansion — COS health

panels.title: Lifecycle hook errors (24h) — MUST be 0
panels.description: cos.lifecycle.hook_error: the swallow-safe hooks (on_enter_watched / on_enter_declined / on_created) failed. Users saw nothing; to-dos/email-sync silently didn't happen. Alert rule fires on >0/h.

panels.title: Doors fail-open (24h) — MUST be 0
panels.description: cos.doors.request{fail_open=true}: GET /cos/verticals hit the fail-open path — flag evaluation is broken and every user silently sees default doors. Alert rule fires when sustained 15m.

panels.title: Taxonomy escapes (24h)
panels.description: cos.type.degraded: get_profile fell back to camp for a NON-NULL type (unknown string, or canonical-but-unregistered). Sustained growth = rows escaping the taxonomy.

panels.title: RRULE rejections (24h)
panels.description: cos.dates.rrule_rejected by edge (tool = the agent proposed it, router = a client sent it). A spike on the tool edge means the agent is hallucinating unsupported recurrence shapes — check the prompt/goldens.

panels.title: Lifecycle transitions by stage
panels.description: cos.lifecycle.transition — the funnel's system-side pulse (product-side lives in PostHog as activity_stage_advanced).

panels.title: Lifecycle transitions by vertical
panels.description: Same counter split by activity_type — is anyone actually using V2/V3 yet?

panels.title: Date-model writes
panels.description: cos.dates.write — week_block vs recurring_weekly through set_activity_dates (the one date write path).

panels.title: LookupAndSaveActivity path
panels.description: cos.lookup.path — candidate reuse is free; the web path spends Tavily + an extraction LLM call per save.

panels.title: Doors requests
panels.description: cos.doors.request — total door-list fetches (both clients refresh on plan load).
